definitions: To appropriate another's idea or invention.
To preempt someone's announcement or success.
To take credit for someone else's work or achievement.
examples: She was about to announce her promotion, but her colleague stole her thunder by revealing his own first.
The new product launch stole the thunder of their competitor's similar announcement.
He always tries to steal my thunder during presentations.
synonyms: to take the wind out of someone's sails
to pull the rug out from under someone
